title: Not All Negative Samples Are Equal: LLMs Learn Better from Plausible Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the mathematical reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) through a new training method called Plausible Negative Samples (PNS). It does not evaluate or benchmark aspects related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics; its evaluation is centered on mathematical benchmarks like MATH500 and AIME.
